plugins.name: firmware-skills
plugins.description: Comprehensive embedded firmware skills: STM32, ESP32, PIC/dsPIC33, Zephyr RTOS, FreeRTOS, embedded Linux (Raspberry Pi, Torizon). Includes 6 agents: firmware-reviewer, crash-analyst, test-writer, datasheet-researcher, architecture-reviewer, linux-bringup-debugger. PlatformIO + Arduino + ESP-IDF support.

plugins.name: home-lab-developer-tools

Includes MCP server for live SSH access to Pi.

plugins.name: kicad-happy
plugins.description: AI-powered KiCad electronics design: schematic/PCB/Gerber parsing, subcircuit detection, SPICE simulation (ngspice/LTspice), EMC pre-compliance (44 rules, FCC/CISPR/automotive), datasheet extraction (DigiKey/Mouser/LCSC), BOM management, JLCPCB/PCBWay fabrication export. 1.8k stars.

plugins.name: opendbc
plugins.description: Automotive CAN bus database: 3.6k stars. Python API for car control (steering, gas, brakes), DBC file repository for 300+ car models, CAN message parsing/building, safety firmware for panda hardware. Used by openpilot. Ideal for automotive reverse engineering, diagnostics, car data extraction.

plugins.name: aurora-smart-home
plugins.description: Complete smart home skills: Home Assistant, ESPHome, Node-RED, custom integrations, dashboards, hardware designs. 112 stars. Covers ESP32 firmware, automations, Lovelace UI, fabrication-ready hardware.
